features.name: Rage
description: As a Bonus Action, you enter a Rage that lasts until the end of your next turn, as long as you aren't wearing Heavy armor. On later turns you can extend it by attacking an enemy, forcing an enemy to make a saving throw, or spending a Bonus Action, up to a total of 10 minutes.

While raging you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and a bonus to the damage of your Strength-based weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks. You can't cast spells or maintain Concentration.
The Rage ends early if you don Heavy armor or have the Incapacitated condition.
You can Rage twice per Long Rest at low levels, rising to five times at level 16, and you regain one use on a Short Rest. The damage bonus is +2, increasing to +3 at level 9 and +4 at level 16.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Constitution modifier. You can still use a Shield and gain this benefit.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of Simple or Martial melee weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those choices, and the number of weapon kinds increases as you gain Barbarian levels.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can choose to attack recklessly, gaining Advantage on your Strength-based attack rolls until the start of your next turn. Attack rolls against you also have Advantage during that time.

features.name: Barbarian Subclass
features.description: You gain a Barbarian subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Barbarian levels.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
description: You gain proficiency in one more skill of your choice from the Barbarian skill list.
In addition, while your Rage is active, you can make an ability check using Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival as a Strength check instead of its normal ability.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: As part of the Bonus Action you take to enter your Rage, you can move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Brutal Strike
description: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo its Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn, provided that roll doesn't have Disadvantage. On a hit, the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the weapon's or Unarmed Strike's type, and you apply one of the following effects.
**Forceful Blow.** The target is pushed 15 feet straight away from you, and you can then move up to half your Speed toward it without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
**Hamstring Blow.** The target's Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. A target can be affected by only one Hamstring Blow at a time.

features.name: Relentless Rage
description: If you drop to 0 Hit Points while your Rage is active and don't die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. On a success, you instead drop to a number of Hit Points equal to twice your Barbarian level.
Each time you use this after the first, the DC increases by 5. It resets to 10 when you finish a Short Rest or a Long Rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
description: You gain two more Brutal Strike effect options.
**Staggering Blow.** The target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw and can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
**Sundering Blow.** Before the start of your next turn, the next attack roll against the target by a creature other than you gains a +5 bonus. An attack roll can gain only one Sundering Blow bonus.

features.name: Persistent Rage
description: When you roll Initiative, you can regain all expended uses of Rage. Once you do this, you can't again until you finish a Long Rest.
In addition, your Rage lasts for 10 minutes without you needing to extend it from round to round. It still ends early if you have the Unconscious condition or don Heavy armor.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: The extra damage of Brutal Strike increases to 2d10, and you can apply two different Brutal Strike effects whenever you use the feature.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If your total for a Strength check or a Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: While your Rage is active, if you use Reckless Attack you deal extra damage to the first creature you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. Roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage damage bonus and add them together; the damage is the same type as the weapon or Unarmed Strike used.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If either condition is affecting you when you enter your Rage, it ends.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
description: As a Bonus Action, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation around you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failure, a creature has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a use of Rage (no action required) to use it again.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: You've formed a supernatural bond with the animal world. You can cast Speak with Animals and Beast Sense, but only in their Ritual versions, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for both spells.

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
description: Your Rage draws on the primal strength of animals. Each time you activate your Rage, choose one of the following benefits to have for its duration.
**Bear.** While raging, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.

**Eagle.** The Bonus Action you use to activate your Rage can also include the Disengage and Dash actions, and while your Rage continues you can take a Bonus Action to use both of those actions again.
**Wolf.** While raging, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy of yours that is within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
description: You take on a lasting animal trait, chosen from the options below. You can swap your choice whenever you finish a Long Rest.
**Owl.** You gain Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet, or that range extends by 60 feet if you already have Darkvision.
**Panther.** You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
**Salmon.** You gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.description: You can cast Commune with Nature, but only in its Ritual version, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

features.name: Power of the Wilds
description: Your Rage now also taps a second primal aspect. Each time you activate your Rage, choose one of the following options as well, alongside your choice for Rage of the Wilds.
**Falcon.** While raging and not wearing armor, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
**Lion.** While raging, enemies within 5 feet of you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than you or another Barbarian who has this same option active.
**Ram.** While raging, a Large or smaller creature you hit with a melee attack can be given the Prone condition.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
description: Your Rage channels the World Tree's own life force, granting the following benefits.
**Vitality Surge.** When you activate your Rage, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level.

**Life-Giving Force.** At the start of each of your turns while raging, you can choose another creature within 10 feet of yourself to gain Temporary Hit Points. Roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage damage bonus and add them together to find the amount. Any of these Temporary Hit Points still remaining when your Rage ends are lost.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: While your Rage is active, you can use your Reaction when a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you to conjure spectral roots and branches of the World Tree around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported into an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of yourself, or otherwise to the nearest unoccupied space you can see. If the target is teleported this way, you can also reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: On your turn, tendrils of the World Tree extend your reach with any Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property by 10 feet. When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can invoke the Push or Topple mastery property together with a different mastery property you're already using with that weapon.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.description: When you activate your Rage, and again as a Bonus Action at any later point while it continues, you can slip through the World Tree's branches to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Once during each Rage, you can extend that teleport's range to 150 feet; when you do, you can bring along up to six willing creatures who are within 10 feet of you, each arriving in an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination space.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: Divine power channels through your attacks. On each of your turns while raging, the first creature you hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level, rounded down. Each time you deal this damage, you choose whether it is Necrotic or Radiant.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
description: A god or pantheon sustains you in battle through a pool of four d12s. As a Bonus Action, you can expend any number of dice from this pool, roll them, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the total rolled.

Your pool regains all of its expended dice when you finish a Long Rest, and its maximum size grows by one die when you reach Barbarian level 6 (five dice), level 12 (six dice), and level 17 (seven dice).

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once during each active Rage, if you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage damage bonus. You must use the new result.

features.name: Zealous Presence
description: As a Bonus Action, you loose a battle cry charged with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures you choose within 60 feet of you gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore its use.

features.name: Rage of the Gods
description: When you activate your Rage, you can also take on the form of a divine warrior. The form lasts for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 Hit Points. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. While in this form, you gain the following benefits.
**Flight.** You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover.
**Resistance.** You have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

**Revivification.** When a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points, you can use your Reaction and expend a use of your Rage to instead set that creature's Hit Points to a number equal to your Barbarian level.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
description: As a Bonus Action, you give one creature within 60 feet of you other than yourself a Bardic Inspiration die, a d6. The creature keeps the die for 1 hour.
Once within that time, when the creature fails a D20 Test, it can roll the die and add it to the d20, potentially turning the failure into a success. The die is then expended.
You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a Long Rest. The die becomes a d8 at level 5, a d10 at level 10, and a d12 at level 15.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Bard spells using Charisma, and you can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus.
You know two cantrips from the Bard spell list and learn more as you gain levels.
You prepare a list of Bard spells whose size is set by your level, and you can change the whole list when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Jack of all Trades
features.description: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to any ability check you make that uses a skill and doesn't already include your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of them.

features.name: Bard Subclass
features.description: You gain a Bard subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Bard levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
description: You regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short Rest, not just a Long Rest.
You can also spend a spell slot to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: When a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw to avoid or end the Frightened or Charmed condition, you can use your Reaction to make that creature reroll the save with Advantage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two more of your skill proficiencies. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of them.

features.name: Magical Secrets
description: When you choose or replace your prepared spells, you can draw from the Cleric, Druid, and Wizard spell lists as well as the Bard list.
A spell chosen this way counts as a Bard spell for you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll Initiative, you regain expended uses of Bardic Inspiration until you have two.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Words of Creation
description: You always have the Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill spells prepared.
When you cast either spell, you can target a second creature with it if that creature is within 10 feet of the first target.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes a damage roll or succeeds on an attack roll or ability check, you can use your Reaction to expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and subtract your Bardic Inspiration die from that roll.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
description: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Each must be a cantrip or a spell of a level you can cast.
These spells are always prepared and count as Bard spells for you. You can replace one of them whenever you gain a Bard level.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you fail an ability check or an attack roll, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to add your Bardic Inspiration die to the roll. If it still fails, the use is not expended.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
description: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier, and you have Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks you make to dance.

Your Unarmed Strikes use Dexterity instead of Strength for their attack and damage rolls, and on a hit you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Dexterity modifier instead of the strike's normal damage.
Whenever you expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that same action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: When a creature you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction and expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. When you do, choose one ally within 30 feet of you; that ally can also move up to half their Speed using their own Reaction, likewise without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: When you roll Initiative, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, provided you aren't Incapacitated, and roll the die. You and each ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you add the number rolled to your Initiative scores.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: Provided you aren't Incapacitated, whenever you are subjected to an effect that lets you make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure. Any creature within 5 feet of you gains this same benefit against that effect.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
description: You always have the Charm Person and Mirror Image spells prepared, and having them prepared doesn't count against the number of spells you can have prepared.

Immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can force one creature you can see within 60 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature has the Charmed or Frightened condition (your choice) for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration and roll the die. Choose a number of creatures you can see within 60 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one); each of them gains Temporary Hit Points equal to twice the number rolled. Any creature that gains Temporary Hit Points this way can immediately use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
description: You always have the Command spell prepared, and you can cast it as a Bonus Action without expending a spell slot. When you cast it this way, you take on a fey, otherworldly presence for 1 minute, or until your concentration on that presence ends as though you were concentrating on a spell.

While the presence lasts, you can cast Command again as a Bonus Action on your turn without expending a spell slot, and any creature already Charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against these castings of Command. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 3rd level or higher to use it again.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can assume a magically majestic presence for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. For that duration, the first time on a creature's turn that it hits you with an attack roll, that creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or the attack instead misses you. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: A creature that has one of your Bardic Inspiration dice can use it for more than turning a failure into a success. Immediately after that creature hits a target with an attack roll, it can roll the die and add the number rolled to the damage dealt. Alternatively, when the creature is hit by an attack roll, it can use its Reaction to roll the die and add the number rolled to its Armor Class against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.

features.name: Martial Training
features.description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons, Medium armor, and Shields. You can also use a Simple or Martial weapon you are holding as a Spellcasting Focus for your Bard spells.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. In addition, you can replace one of those attacks with the casting of one of your cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: Immediately after you cast a spell with a casting time of an action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Cleric spells using Wisdom, and you can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.
You know three cantrips from the Cleric spell list and learn more as you gain levels.
You prepare a list of Cleric spells whose size is set by your level, and you can change the whole list when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Divine Order
description: You gain one of the following options.
**Protector.** You gain training with Martial weapons and Heavy armor.
**Thaumaturge.** You know one extra cantrip from the Cleric spell list, and you add your Wisdom modifier to your Arcana and Religion checks (minimum of +1).

features.name: Channel Divinity
description: You can channel divine energy to fuel one of the following effects, choosing which each time you use it. You have two uses, and a third at level 6, regaining one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

**Divine Spark.** As a Magic action, you point your Holy Symbol at a creature within 30 feet of you and either restore its Hit Points or force a Constitution saving throw for Radiant or Necrotic damage. The amount is 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier, and it increases at levels 7, 13, and 18.

**Turn Undead.** As a Magic action, each Undead within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute, spending its turns moving away from you. The effect ends early on a creature that takes damage.

features.name: Cleric Subclass
features.description: You gain a Cleric subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Cleric levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.description: Whenever you use Turn Undead, each Undead that fails its saving throw also takes Radiant damage equal to a roll of d8s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die).

features.name: Blessed Strikes
description: You gain one of the following options.
**Divine Strike.** Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage.
**Potent Spellcasting.** You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: As a Magic action, you cast any Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that doesn't require a Reaction, without spending a spell slot or providing Material components. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
description: Your Blessed Strikes option improves.
**Divine Strike.** The extra damage increases to 2d8.
**Potent Spellcasting.** Whenever a Cleric cantrip of yours deals damage, you can also give Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier to yourself or a creature within 60 feet of you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
description: When you use Divine Intervention, you can choose the Wish spell instead of a Cleric spell of level 5 or lower.
If you cast Wish this way, you can't use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests. Otherwise it recharges on a Long Rest.

features.name: Life Domain Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Cleric level shown.
**Level 3.** Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration
**Level 5.** Mass Healing Word, Revivify
**Level 7.** Aura of Life, Death Ward
**Level 9.** Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Whenever a spell slot you spend restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains an extra 2 Hit Points plus the level of the slot.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend one use of Channel Divinity to divide a pool of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of you. This can't raise a creature above half its Hit Point maximum.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: Whenever a spell slot you spend restores Hit Points to another creature, you also regain 2 Hit Points plus the level of the slot.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: Whenever a spell or Channel Divinity of yours would roll dice to restore Hit Points, use the highest possible result for each die instead of rolling.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Cleric level shown.
**Level 3.** Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility
**Level 5.** Daylight, Fireball
**Level 7.** Arcane Eye, Wall of Fire
**Level 9.** Flame Strike, Scrying

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend one use of Channel Divinity and unleash sunlight in a 30-foot Emanation, ending any magical darkness in the area. Each hostile creature in the Emanation must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 plus your Cleric level Radiant damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend one use of Warding Flare to sear the air with light, giving that roll Disadvantage. You have a number of uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: Warding Flare now also recharges on a Short Rest, and whenever you use it, the creature whose attack you hindered gains 2d6 plus your Wisdom modifier Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend one use of this feature to radiate Bright Light in a 60-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet beyond that, lasting for 1 minute or until you dismiss it (no action required). While a creature is in that Bright Light, it has Disadvantage on saving throws against your Radiance of the Dawn and against any spell of yours that deals Fire or Radiant damage. You have a number of uses equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Cleric level shown.
**Level 3.** Charm Person, Disguise Self, Invisibility, Pass without Trace
**Level 5.** Hypnotic Pattern, Nondetection
**Level 7.** Confusion, Dimension Door
**Level 9.** Dominate Person, Modify Memory

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: As a Magic action, you grant yourself or a willing creature within 30 feet of you Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This benefit lasts until you finish a Long Rest or use this feature again.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
description: As a Bonus Action, you expend one use of Channel Divinity to create a perfect illusory duplicate of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you. The illusion is intangible, occupies no space, and copies your expressions and gestures; it lasts for 1 minute, until you dismiss it (no action required), or until you gain the Incapacitated condition. As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, provided the new space is within 120 feet of you.

While the illusion exists, you can cast your spells as though you occupied its space, though you must still rely on your own senses. Whenever you and the illusion are both within 5 feet of the same creature that can see the illusion, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: Whenever you take the Bonus Action to create or move the illusion from Invoke Duplicity, you can instead teleport, swapping places with the illusion.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: Attack rolls made by you and your allies against a creature within 5 feet of your Invoke Duplicity illusion now also gain Advantage. In addition, when the illusion ends, you or a creature of your choice within 5 feet of it regains Hit Points equal to your Cleric level.

features.name: War Domain Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Cleric level shown.
**Level 3.** Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon
**Level 5.** Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians
**Level 7.** Fire Shield, Freedom of Movement
**Level 9.** Hold Monster, Steel Wind Strike

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: When you or a creature within 30 feet of you misses with an attack roll, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to grant that roll a +10 bonus, potentially turning it into a hit. Using this feature to help someone other than yourself requires you to take a Reaction.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike. You can take this Bonus Action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: You can expend one use of Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without using a spell slot. A spell cast this way doesn't require Concentration; instead it lasts for 1 minute, ending early if you cast that spell again, if you gain the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Druid spells using Wisdom, and you can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.
You know two cantrips from the Druid spell list and learn more as you gain levels.
You prepare a list of Druid spells whose size is set by your level, and you can change the whole list when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Druidic
description: You know Druidic, the secret language of Druids. You can use it to leave hidden messages that others who know Druidic spot automatically and that others notice only with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check and can't decipher without magic.
You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared.

features.name: Primal Order
description: You gain one of the following options.
**Magician.** You know one extra cantrip from the Druid spell list, and you add your Wisdom modifier to your Arcana and Nature checks (minimum of +1).
**Warden.** You gain training with Martial weapons and Medium armor.

features.name: Wild Shape
description: As a Bonus Action, you transform into a Beast form you have learned, and you can revert to your true form as a Bonus Action. Otherwise the form lasts a number of hours equal to half your Druid level.
You have two uses, regaining one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest, and you gain another use at levels 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, and 18.
You start knowing four forms, chosen from Beasts of Challenge Rating 1/4 or lower with no Fly Speed. The limit rises to CR 1/2 at level 4 and to CR 1, with a Fly Speed allowed, at level 8.
While transformed, you use the Beast's stat block but keep your Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, Hit Points, class features, and feats. You can't cast spells, but you can keep Concentration going.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast Find Familiar without Material components. The familiar is a Fey and lasts a number of hours equal to half your Druid level.

features.name: Druid Subclass
features.description: You gain a Druid subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Druid levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Wild Resurgence
description: Once on each of your turns, you can spend a spell slot to regain one use of Wild Shape.
Once per Long Rest, you can turn a use of Wild Shape into a level 1 spell slot.

features.name: Elemental Fury
description: You gain one of the following options.
**Potent Spellcasting.** You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Druid cantrips.
**Primal Strike.** Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon or a Wild Shape form's attack, you can deal an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
description: Your Elemental Fury option improves.
**Potent Spellcasting.** The range of your damaging Druid cantrips increases by 300 feet.
**Primal Strike.** The extra damage increases to 2d8.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Beast Spells
description: While using Wild Shape, you can cast your Druid spells, replacing their Verbal and Somatic components with sounds and movements of your current form.
You still can't cast a spell whose Material components have a cost or are consumed by the spell.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Archdruid
description: Whenever you roll Initiative and have no uses of Wild Shape left, you regain one use.
Once per Long Rest, you can spend a use of Wild Shape to gain one level 2 spell slot or two level 1 spell slots.
In addition, you age only one year for every ten that pass, and magic can't age you.

features.name: Circle of the Land Spells
description: When you gain this feature, choose a land type: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the choice.
You gain spells determined by that land type. They are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, becoming available at Druid levels 3, 5, 7, and 9.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: As a Magic action, you expend a use of Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of you. Each creature of your choice in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. One creature of your choice in that area also regains 2d6 Hit Points. Both the damage and the healing increase by 1d6 at Druid levels 6, 10, and 14.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to half your Druid level (rounded up), none of them level 6 or higher. Once you do this, you can't again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition. You also gain Resistance to a damage type set by your current land choice: Cold for polar, Fire for arid, Lightning for temperate, or Poison for tropical.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
description: As a Magic action, you conjure nature spirits that fill a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 60 feet of you for 1 minute. Choose any number of creatures you can see in that area.
For the duration, a chosen creature has Half Cover while in the Cube, and the area is Difficult Terrain for creatures you didn't choose.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
description: You forge a bond with lunar magic. You always have Cure Wounds, Moonbeam, and Starry Wisp prepared, joined by Conjure Animals at Druid level 5, Fount of Moonlight at level 7, and Mass Cure Wounds at level 9. None of these spells count against your prepared total.

While transformed by Wild Shape, you can cast any of these spells that don't require Material components with a cost or that are consumed, replacing their Verbal and Somatic components with sounds and movements your current form can make.

features.name: Circle Forms
description: Your Wild Shape grows fiercer. Instead of the Challenge Rating your Druid level would normally allow, you can transform into a Beast with a Challenge Rating as high as your Druid level divided by 3, rounded down (minimum of 1).

Whenever you transform, your Armor Class becomes 13 plus your Wisdom modifier if that total is higher than the Beast form's own AC, and you gain temporary Hit Points equal to three times your Druid level.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
description: Your Circle Forms grow stronger in two ways, both of which apply whenever you're transformed by Wild Shape.
**Lunar Radiance.** Each time an attack from your Wild Shape form hits, you can have it deal Radiant damage instead of its normal damage type.
**Increased Toughness.** You add your Wisdom modifier to Constitution saving throws.

features.name: Moonlight Step
description: As a Bonus Action, you flicker through a wash of moonlight, teleporting up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You then have Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of the current turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Lunar Form
description: Your Lunar Radiance sharpens. Once on each of your turns when an attack from your Wild Shape form deals damage you've changed to Radiant with Lunar Radiance and the attack hits, you deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage.
In addition, when you use Moonlight Step, you can bring one willing creature within 10 feet of you along for the teleport, moving it to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of your destination.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.description: You forge a bond with the ocean's fury. You always have Fog Cloud, Gust of Wind, Ray of Frost, Shatter, and Thunderwave prepared, joined by Lightning Bolt and Water Breathing at Druid level 5, Control Water and Ice Storm at level 7, and Conjure Elemental and Hold Monster at level 9. None of these spells count against your prepared total.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
description: As a Bonus Action, you expend a use of Wild Shape and wreathe yourself in stinging spray and churning water, filling a 5-foot Emanation originating from you. The Emanation lasts for 10 minutes, until you dismiss it (no action required), until you're Incapacitated, or until you use this feature again.

While the Emanation persists, you can take a Bonus Action on your turn to lash out with it: choose one creature within the Emanation. That creature makes a Constitution saving throw, taking Cold damage equal to a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die) on a failed save, and if it's Large or smaller, it's also pushed up to 15 feet away from you. On a success, the creature takes no damage and isn't pushed.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: Your Wrath of the Sea Emanation widens to a 10-foot radius, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: While your Wrath of the Sea Emanation is active, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you have Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
description: When you activate Wrath of the Sea, you can center its Emanation on a willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you instead of yourself. That creature gains all the benefits of the Emanation, using your spell save DC and Wisdom modifier for them.
Alternatively, you can expend two uses of Wild Shape to center the Emanation on both yourself and one other willing creature within 60 feet of you at the same time.

features.name: Star Map
description: You craft a Tiny object charting the heavens — a scroll, a tattoo, or a similar token — that serves as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells. While you're holding or wearing it, you always have the Guidance and Guiding Bolt spells prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt through it without expending a spell slot. You can cast it this way a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
If your Star Map is lost or destroyed, you can create a replacement with an hour-long ceremony, which you can perform during a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Starry Form
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to cloak yourself in starlight instead of shapeshifting. For 10 minutes, glowing lines connect your joints like a star chart, shedding Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. The form ends early if you're Incapacitated, if you dismiss it (no action required), or if you use this feature again. While in this form, you keep your own game statistics.
When you assume the form, choose one of the following constellations; its benefit lasts until the form ends.

**Archer.** When you assume this form, and again as a Bonus Action on later turns while it lasts, you loose a mote of light at one creature you can see within 60 feet, making a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier Radiant damage.

**Chalice.** Whenever you cast a spell using a spell slot that restores Hit Points to a creature, you or one other creature within 30 feet of you regains additional Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier.
**Dragon.** Whenever you make an Intelligence check, a Wisdom check, or a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
description: When you finish a Long Rest, roll 1d20 to divine the omen guiding you until your next Long Rest: an even roll means your omen is Weal, and an odd roll means it's Woe.

As a Reaction when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can roll 1d6 and apply it to that roll's total — adding it if your omen is Weal, or subtracting it if your omen is Woe.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
description: Your constellations shine brighter, and you can change which one lights your Starry Form at the start of each of your turns without needing to reactivate the form.
**Archer.** The Radiant damage of your ranged spell attack increases to 2d8 plus your Wisdom modifier.
**Chalice.** The extra Hit Points regained increase to 2d8 plus your Wisdom modifier.
**Dragon.** You also gain a Fly Speed of 20 feet, and you can hover.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in your Starry Form, your body thins into scattered points of starlight, giving you Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You take a Fighting Style feat, shaping how you prefer to fight.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: A bonus action heals you for a roll plus your fighter level, a number of times per rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery property of a few weapon kinds, changing them as you level.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Once per rest you take one extra action on your turn.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: When you fail an ability check you can spend a use of Second Wind to add a die to it rather than spending the heal.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Fighter levels.

features.description: You attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: When you use Second Wind you can also move without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: When you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level and must use the new roll. You regain the use when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.description: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.description: You can attack three times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.description: You can use Indomitable twice between Long Rests.

features.name: Studied Attacks

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
