features.name: Action Surge
features.description: You can use Action Surge twice between rests, but only once on the same turn.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: You can use Indomitable three times between Long Rests.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.description: You can attack four times, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
description: You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already include it.
In addition, when you make a running Long Jump, the distance it covers increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a second Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.description: During combat, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration whenever you start your turn without it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes now score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18 to 20.

features.name: Survivor
description: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and whenever you roll 18 to 20 on one, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20.
In addition, at the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point.

features.name: Combat Superiority
description: You learn maneuvers that let you do something special when the moment calls for it, each one fueled by a Superiority Die. You know three maneuvers of your choice, and you learn additional ones as you gain levels in this class. Whenever you reach a new Fighter level, you can also swap one maneuver you know for a different one.

You have four Superiority Dice, each a d8. A die is spent when a maneuver calls for it, and you regain all of your spent dice when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You gain one more Superiority Die at Fighter levels 7 and 15. When a maneuver requires the target to make a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, whichever you choose.
Your maneuver options are as follows. Unless a maneuver says otherwise, using one doesn't require an action beyond the attack or reaction that triggers it.
**Ambush.** When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, you can expend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll.

**Bait and Switch.** On your turn, if you're within 5 feet of a willing creature that isn't Incapacitated, you can expend a Superiority Die and trade places with it (at least 5 feet of your movement, no Opportunity Attack provoked). Roll the die: until the start of your next turn, either you or that creature gains a bonus to AC equal to the roll.

**Commander's Strike.** When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks and expend a Superiority Die to direct a willing ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. That ally can use its Reaction to make one weapon attack, adding the die to the damage roll on a hit.
**Commanding Presence.** When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend a Superiority Die and add it to the check.

**Disarming Attack.** When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll. The target must then succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one item of your choice that it's holding.

**Distracting Strike.** When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll. Until the start of your next turn, the next attack roll against that target by a creature other than you has Advantage.
**Evasive Footwork.** As a Bonus Action, you can expend a Superiority Die and take the Disengage action. Roll the die and add it to your AC until the start of your next turn.

**Feinting Attack.** As a Bonus Action, you can expend a Superiority Die to feint against a creature within 5 feet of you. You have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature this turn, and if it hits, add the die to the damage roll.

**Goading Attack.** When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll. The target must then succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the end of your next turn.

**Lunging Attack.** As a Bonus Action, you can expend a Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 5 feet in a straight line right before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action this turn, you can add the die to that attack's damage roll.

**Maneuvering Attack.** When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll, then choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target of your attack.

**Menacing Attack.** When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll. The target must then succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or gain the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

**Parry.** When another creature's melee attack damages you, you can take a Reaction and expend a Superiority Die to reduce that damage by the roll plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, your choice.
**Precision Attack.** When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend a Superiority Die and add the roll to the attack roll, possibly turning it into a hit.

**Pushing Attack.** When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a weapon or Unarmed Strike attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll. The target must then succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

**Rally.** As a Bonus Action, you can expend a Superiority Die to bolster an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you. That ally gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the die roll plus half your Fighter level, rounded down.
**Riposte.** When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can take a Reaction and expend a Superiority Die to make a melee attack against it. If you hit, add the die to the damage roll.

**Sweeping Attack.** When you hit a creature with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike attack, you can expend a Superiority Die and choose a second creature within 5 feet of the first and within your reach. If your attack roll would also hit that second creature, it takes damage equal to the die roll, of the same type as the original attack.
**Tactical Assessment.** When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend a Superiority Die and add it to the check.

**Trip Attack.** When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a weapon or Unarmed Strike attack, you can expend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage roll. The target must then succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice, along with proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Fighter class's list of skill options.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can size up a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, learning whether it has any damage Vulnerabilities, Resistances, or Immunities, and which ones if so. You can use this feature once, regaining its use when you finish a Long Rest, or you can restore it immediately by expending one Superiority Die.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority
features.description: Your Superiority Dice each grow from a d8 to a d10.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use that result to fuel it instead of expending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d12)
features.description: Your Superiority Dice each grow from a d10 to a d12.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You learn to cast spells drawn from the Wizard spell list, with no restriction to a particular school of magic. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and you can use an Arcane Focus as a spellcasting focus.

You know two Wizard cantrips of your choice, learning a third at 10th level; whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can also swap one cantrip you know for a different one. Separately, you prepare a number of 1st-level or higher Wizard spells equal to your Intelligence modifier plus half your Fighter level (rounded down), with a minimum of one spell, and you can change your prepared spells after finishing a Long Rest. Casting one of these prepared spells uses a spell slot, and you regain all expended spell slots when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: War Bond
description: Through a ritual taking 1 hour, which can be performed during a Short Rest, you forge a magical bond with a weapon. You can be bonded to up to two weapons at once; forming a bond with a third breaks your bond with one of the other two.

While a weapon is bonded to you, you can't be disarmed of it unless you're Incapacitated, and you can call it to your hand as a Bonus Action if it's on the same plane of existence as you. You can summon only one bonded weapon this way at a time.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with the casting of a cantrip from your spell list that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: Whenever you use Action Surge, you can also teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, either before or after the extra action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can now replace two of your attacks with the casting of a 1st- or 2nd-level Wizard spell that has a casting time of an action.

features.name: Psionic Power
description: Your latent psionics fuel a pool of Psionic Energy Dice, each currently a d6. You have a number of these dice equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus, and their size grows as you gain Fighter levels: d8 at 5th level, d10 at 11th level, and d12 at 17th level. You regain all expended Psionic Energy Dice when you finish a Long Rest, and as a Bonus Action you can regain a single expended die, though you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

As a Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die to lessen it, rolling the die and reducing the damage by the number rolled plus your Intelligence modifier.

Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die to charge the weapon with psionic force, rolling the die and dealing that much extra Force damage, plus your Intelligence modifier.

As a Magic action, you can telekinetically seize a Large or smaller object or a willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you and move it up to 30 feet to a point you can see; a Tiny object can instead fly directly to or from your hand. Once you use this action, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore its use immediately.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die to sheathe yourself in psionic force, gaining a Flying Speed equal to twice your Speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore its use immediately.

In addition, whenever your Psionic Strike deals damage to a creature, you can force it to make a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Intelligence modifier. On a failed save, you choose to either knock the creature Prone or move it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage. In addition, at the start of each of your turns, if you are Charmed or Frightened, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die, with no action required, to end that condition on yourself.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die to raise a shimmering field of psionic force around yourself, granting Half Cover to yourself and to a number of other creatures within 30 feet of you equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). The field lasts for 1 minute or until you're Incapacitated. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore its use immediately.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: You can cast the Telekinesis spell, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability, without expending a spell slot and without needing any material components. While you're concentrating on the spell cast this way, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action on each of your turns. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die to restore its use immediately.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Your unarmed strikes use a Martial Arts die for damage, you may use Dexterity for their attack and damage rolls, and you can make an extra unarmed strike as a bonus action when you attack.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While wearing no armor and no shield, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Monk's Focus
features.description: You gain Focus Points equal to your monk level, spent on Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind. They return on a short or long rest.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases while you wear no armor and no shield, improving further as you gain levels.

features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
features.description: Once per long rest, when you roll Initiative you can regain all spent Focus Points and heal yourself.

features.name: Monk Subclass
features.description: You gain a Monk subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Monk levels.

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.description: As a reaction you can reduce the damage of an attack against you, and if you drop it to nothing you may spend Focus to redirect the force at another creature.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: As a reaction when you fall, you reduce the falling damage you take.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Once per turn you can spend a Focus Point to force a hit creature to make a Constitution save or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your unarmed strikes can deal force damage instead of their normal type.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When an effect calls for a Dexterity save for half damage, you take none on a success and half on a failure.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.description: While unarmored and without a shield you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling during your move.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.description: Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind each become more potent for the same cost.

features.name: Self-Restoration
features.description: You can end one condition on yourself at the end of your turn, and you no longer suffer exhaustion from going without food or drink.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.description: Deflect Attacks now works against any attack that deals Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Piercing, Slashing, or Thunder damage, not just Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing.

features.name: Disciplined Survivor
description: You gain proficiency in all saving throws.
In addition, you can spend 1 Focus Point to reroll a saving throw you failed, and you must use the new roll.

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.description: When you roll Initiative and have 3 Focus Points or fewer, you regain enough Focus Points to have 4.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Superior Defense
features.description: At the start of your turn, you can spend 3 Focus Points to give yourself Resistance to all damage except Force damage for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Body and Mind
features.description: Your Dexterity and Wisdom scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
description: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target.
**Addle.** The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
**Push.** The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.
**Topple.** The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you roll your Martial Arts die and regain Hit Points equal to the roll plus your Wisdom modifier. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per Long Rest.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.description: Whenever you take a Bonus Action that isn't Step of the Wind, you also gain the benefit of Step of the Wind.

features.name: Quivering Palm
description: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can spend 4 Focus Points to set up lethal vibrations in its body that last a number of days equal to your Monk level. A creature with Immunity to the Stunned condition is unaffected.

While the vibrations last, you can take a Magic action to end them, forcing the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure it drops to 0 Hit Points, and on a success it takes 10d12 Force damage.
You can have only one creature affected at a time, and you can end the vibrations harmlessly without an action.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Once on each of your turns, when one of your Unarmed Strikes deals damage, you can spend 1 Focus Point to add extra Necrotic damage to that hit equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: As a Magic action, you can spend 1 Focus Point and touch a creature to restore Hit Points to it equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier. When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of its Unarmed Strikes with this healing touch at no Focus Point cost.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Insight and Medicine skills, along with proficiency with the Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
description: Hand of Harm and Hand of Healing both gain an additional effect.
**Hand of Harm.** A creature damaged by this feature can also be left with the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
**Hand of Healing.** A creature restored by this feature can also have one of the following conditions removed from it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
description: A number of times per Long Rest equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), you can use Hand of Healing and Hand of Harm without spending Focus Points.

During a Flurry of Blows you use this way, you can replace any number of its Unarmed Strikes with Hand of Healing, and you can still apply Hand of Harm's extra damage to one of the strikes that hits, all without spending Focus Points; Hand of Harm's once-per-turn limit still applies.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
description: Once per Long Rest, as a Magic action, you can spend 5 Focus Points and touch the corpse of a creature that died within the last 24 hours.
That creature returns to life with Hit Points equal to 4d10 plus your Wisdom modifier, and it loses the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, and Stunned conditions.

features.name: Shadow Arts
description: You draw on the power of the Shadowfell, gaining the following benefits.

**Darkness.** You can spend 1 Focus Point to cast Darkness without needing any spell components, and you can see normally through the area it creates. While the spell lasts, you can shift its area to a point within 60 feet of yourself at the start of each of your turns.
**Darkvision.** You gain Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet, or the range of your existing Darkvision increases by 60 feet.
**Shadowy Figments.** You learn the Minor Illusion spell, which you cast using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: While you are entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can take a Bonus Action to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in Dim Light or Darkness. You have Advantage on the next melee attack roll you make before the end of the turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.description: When you use Shadow Step, you can spend 1 Focus Point so that neither your start nor end point needs to be in Dim Light or Darkness, and you can make an Unarmed Strike immediately after you teleport as part of the same Bonus Action.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
description: While you are entirely within Dim Light or Darkness, you can take a Magic action and spend 3 Focus Points to wrap yourself in shadow for 1 minute, until you gain the Incapacitated condition, or until you end a turn in Bright Light.

While shrouded this way, you have the Invisible condition, you can move through other creatures' spaces as if they were Difficult Terrain (if you end your turn inside one, you are shunted back to the last unoccupied space you occupied), and you can use Flurry of Blows without spending Focus Points.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
description: You learn the Elementalism cantrip, using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability for it.

At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 Focus Point to call up elemental energy that lasts for 10 minutes or until you have the Incapacitated condition. While it lasts, your Unarmed Strikes have 10 extra feet of reach, and you can have them deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (your choice) instead of their normal damage type. A creature hit by such a strike must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved up to 10 feet toward or away from you, your choice.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.description: As a Magic action, you can spend 2 Focus Points to erupt elemental energy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Each creature in the Sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking damage of your choice of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die on a failure, or half as much damage on a success.

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.description: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you gain a Fly Speed and a Swim Speed, each equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
description: While your Elemental Attunement is active, you gain the following benefits.
**Damage Resistance.** At the start of each of your turns, you choose one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder and have Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.

**Destructive Stride.** When you use Step of the Wind, your Speed increases by 20 feet until the end of the turn, and each creature you come within 5 feet of during that movement takes damage of the type you chose for your Elemental Attunement, equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die; no creature can be damaged this way more than once per turn.
**Empowered Strikes.** Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal extra damage to it equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die.

features.name: Lay On Hands
description: You have a pool of healing power that equals five times your Paladin level and refreshes when you finish a Long Rest.
As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature and restore Hit Points to it from the pool, up to the amount remaining.
You can instead spend 5 Hit Points from the pool to end the Poisoned condition on the creature or neutralize a poison affecting it.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Paladin spells using Charisma, and you can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.
You prepare a list of Paladin spells whose size is set by your level, and you can change the whole list when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those choices.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. You can replace it with a different Fighting Style feat whenever you gain a Paladin level.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared. You can also cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain that ability when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity
description: You can channel divine energy to fuel magical effects. You have two uses, regaining one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest, and your subclass grants additional effects.

**Divine Sense.** As a Bonus Action, you can sense the location and type of any Celestial, Fiend, or Undead within 60 feet of you that isn't behind Total Cover. This lasts until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Paladin Subclass
features.description: You gain a Paladin subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Paladin levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.description: You always have the Find Steed spell prepared. You can also cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain that ability when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: While you don't have the Incapacitated condition, you and your allies within 10 feet of you gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Abjure Foes
description: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to sear the spirits of up to a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) that you can see within 60 feet of you.

Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While Frightened this way, a target can't move, and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: While you don't have the Incapacitated condition, you and your allies within 10 feet of you have Immunity to the Frightened condition. An ally who is already Frightened has that condition suppressed while in the aura.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you deal an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.description: When you use Lay On Hands, you can also spend 5 Hit Points from its pool to end one of the following conditions on the creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.description: Your Aura of Protection and Aura of Courage each extend 30 feet from you instead of 10 feet.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Paladin level shown.
**Level 3.** Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith
**Level 5.** Aid, Zone of Truth
**Level 9.** Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic
**Level 13.** Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith
**Level 17.** Commune, Flame Strike

features.name: Sacred Weapon
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to imbue one weapon you are holding with positive energy for 10 minutes or until you end the effect.
For the duration, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls with that weapon (minimum +1), and the weapon emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an extra 20 feet.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: While you don't have the Incapacitated condition, you and your allies within 10 feet of you have Immunity to the Charmed condition. An ally who is already Charmed has that condition suppressed while in the aura.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies within 10 feet of you gain Half Cover until the start of your next turn, protected by spectral wings that spring from your back.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
description: As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with holy power for 10 minutes or until you end the effect. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a level 5 spell slot to use it again.

For the duration, the aura is filled with Bright Light, whenever an enemy starts its turn in the aura it takes Radiant damage equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus, and you have Advantage on saving throws against spells cast by Fiends and Undead.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Paladin level shown.
**Level 3.** Ensnaring Strike, Speak with Animals
**Level 5.** Misty Step, Moonbeam
**Level 9.** Plant Growth, Protection from Energy
**Level 13.** Ice Storm, Stoneskin
**Level 17.** Commune with Nature, Tree Stride

features.name: Nature's Wrath
description: As a Magic action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to call up grasping spectral vines around your enemies, targeting any number of creatures you can see within 15 feet of you.
Each target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the Restrained condition for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to break free early.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: While you don't have the Incapacitated condition, you and your allies within your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
description: When damage would reduce you to 0 Hit Points but not kill you outright, you can instead drop to 1 Hit Point and regain Hit Points equal to three times your Paladin level. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
You also stop aging visibly and can no longer be aged by magic.

features.name: Elder Champion
description: As a Bonus Action, you can imbue your Aura of Protection with primal might for 1 minute or until you end the effect early. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a level 5 spell slot to use it again.

For the duration, you regain 10 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns, you can cast any Paladin spell that normally has a casting time of an action by using a Bonus Action instead, and enemies within the aura have Disadvantage on saving throws against your Paladin spells and Channel Divinity options.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Paladin level shown.
**Level 3.** Guiding Bolt, Heroism
**Level 5.** Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon
**Level 9.** Haste, Protection from Energy
**Level 13.** Compulsion, Freedom of Movement
**Level 17.** Legend Lore, Yolande's Regal Presence

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.description: Immediately after you cast Divine Smite, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to turn your triumph into Temporary Hit Points, dividing a pool equal to 2d8 plus your Paladin level among any creatures you choose within 30 feet of you, including yourself.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to call on legendary vigor.
For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and the distance of your Long Jumps and High Jumps increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, and whenever an ally enters your Aura of Protection for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that ally's Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense
description: When an attack roll hits you or another creature you can see within 10 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to grant the target a bonus to AC against that attack equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1), potentially turning the hit into a miss. If the attack misses because of this bonus, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of the same Reaction, provided the attacker is within your weapon's range.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Living Legend
description: As a Bonus Action, you gain the benefits below for 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a level 5 spell slot to use it again.

For the duration, you have Advantage on Charisma checks, once on each of your turns you can turn a missed weapon attack into a hit, and whenever you fail a saving throw you can use your Reaction to reroll it, using the new result.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your prepared total, each becoming available at the Paladin level shown.
**Level 3.** Bane, Hunter's Mark
**Level 5.** Hold Person, Misty Step
**Level 9.** Haste, Protection from Energy
**Level 13.** Banishment, Dimension Door
**Level 17.** Hold Monster, Scrying

features.name: Vow of Enmity
description: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to swear a vow of enmity against one creature you can see within 30 feet of you, gaining Advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.
If the target drops to 0 Hit Points before the vow ends, you can transfer it to a different creature within 30 feet of you, requiring no action.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, you can reduce that creature's Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn, then immediately move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction, without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: Immediately after the creature bound by your Vow of Enmity hits or misses with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to make one melee attack against it, provided it is within reach of your attack.

features.name: Avenging Angel
description: As a Bonus Action, you can take on an avenging, angelic form for 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a level 5 spell slot to use it again.

For the duration, spectral wings grant you a Flying Speed of 60 feet and let you hover, and you radiate menace throughout your Aura of Protection: the first time an enemy enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute or until it takes damage, and attack rolls against a creature Frightened this way have Advantage.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Ranger spells using Wisdom, and you can use a Druidic Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.
You prepare a list of Ranger spells whose size is set by your level, and you can change the whole list when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Favored Enemy
description: You always have the Hunter's Mark spell prepared.
You can cast it without expending a spell slot a number of times per Long Rest, starting at twice and increasing as you reach higher Ranger levels.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those choices.

features.name: Deft Explorer
description: You gain Expertise in one skill of your choice in which you have proficiency.
You also learn two languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. You can replace it with a different Fighting Style feat whenever you gain a Ranger level.

features.name: Ranger Subclass
features.description: You gain a Ranger subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Ranger levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Roving
features.description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also gain a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skills in which you have proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of them.

features.name: Tireless
description: As a Magic action, you can give yourself Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per Long Rest.
In addition, whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level decreases by 1.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.description: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on the Hunter's Mark spell.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can give yourself the Invisible condition until the end of your next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per Long Rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.description: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Feral Senses
description: You gain Blindsight with a range of 30 feet.
In addition, you always know the location of a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark if it is within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: The extra damage of your Hunter's Mark is a d10 rather than a d6. In addition, when the marked creature drops to 0 Hit Points, you can move the mark to a new creature as part of the same Bonus Action or no action.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.description: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know whether it has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and if it does, you know what they are.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
description: You gain one of the following options.
**Colossus Slayer.** Once on each of your turns, you deal an extra 1d8 damage to a creature you hit that is below its Hit Point maximum.

**Horde Breaker.** Once on each of your turns, when you make an attack with a weapon, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5 feet of the first target and within range.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
description: You gain one of the following options.
**Escape the Horde.** Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.
**Multiattack Defense.** When a creature hits you with an attack roll, that creature has Disadvantage on all other attack rolls against you this turn.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the first.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: When you take damage, you can use your Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage's type until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering damage.

features.name: Primal Companion
description: You magically call forth a Primal Beast, a nature spirit that takes the form of a beast of the land, the sea, or the sky (your choice); its game statistics are given separately and scale with your Ranger level rather than needing a stat block of its own. The beast is friendly to you and your companions and obeys your commands.

In combat, the beast acts on your turn. It can move and use its Reaction on its own, but the only action it takes without direction is Dodge. Spend a Bonus Action to command it into any action its stat block allows, or forgo one of your own attacks when you take the Attack action to have it make its Beast's Strike alongside you.

If the beast dies, you can restore it within the following hour by using a Magic action to touch its body and expend a spell slot of any level; it revives after 1 minute with all its Hit Points restored. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you may instead summon a beast of a different form.

features.name: Exceptional Training
description: Commanding your beast becomes more versatile: the Bonus Action you spend to direct it can now also send it into the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action, in addition to the options it already had.

In addition, whenever the beast hits with an attack and deals damage, you can have that damage become Force damage instead of its normal type, letting it get past many creatures' resistances and immunities.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: When you command your Primal Beast to take the Attack action, it can attack twice instead of once, or use its Multiattack action if its stat block has one.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: Whenever you cast a spell that targets only yourself, you can also apply its effect to your Primal Beast if the beast is within 30 feet of you when you cast it.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
description: You can lace your weapon strikes with unsettling magic drawn from the Feywild. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 Psychic damage to it.
This extra damage increases to 1d6 once you reach 11th level.

features.name: Fey Wanderer Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared once you reach the Ranger levels shown in the Fey Wanderer Spells table, and they don't count against the number of spells you can prepare. You gain Charm Person at 3rd level, Misty Step at 5th, Summon Fey at 9th, Dimension Door at 13th, and Mislead at 17th.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: A fey grace settles over you. Whenever you make a Charisma check, you add your Wisdom modifier to the roll, to a minimum bonus of +1. You also gain proficiency in one skill of your choice from Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
description: You have Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened.

Whenever you or a creature you can see within 120 feet of you succeeds on such a save, you can use your Reaction to turn the attempt back on its source: force a different creature you can see within 120 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, that creature is Charmed or Frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: You no longer need a Material component to cast Summon Fey, and you can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it this way when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
description: You can cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
Whenever you cast Misty Step, you can bring one willing creature you can see within 5 feet of you along with you to the destination space.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
description: You've mastered the opening strike of an ambush, gaining three benefits.
**Ambusher's Leap.** At the start of your first turn of each combat, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

**Dreadful Strike.** Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 2d6 Psychic damage to it. You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
**Initiative Bonus.** You can add your Wisdom modifier to your Initiative rolls.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared once you reach the Ranger levels shown in the Gloom Stalker Spells table, and they don't count against the number of spells you can prepare. You gain Disguise Self at 3rd level, Rope Trick at 5th, Fear at 9th, Greater Invisibility at 13th, and Seeming at 17th.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: You gain Darkvision out to a range of 60 feet; if you already have Darkvision, its range instead increases by 30 feet. While you're in Darkness, you have the benefit of the Invisible condition against any creature relying on Darkvision to see you there.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Your will hardens against attempts to bend it. You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have that proficiency, you instead gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you without Advantage, you can use your Reaction, before knowing whether the attack hits, to impose Disadvantage on that roll.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two skills in which you have proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of them.

features.name: Sneak Attack
description: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack roll if you have Advantage on the roll and the attack uses a Finesse or Ranged weapon. You don't need Advantage if another of the target's enemies is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't Incapacitated, and you don't have Disadvantage on the roll.
The extra damage is 1d6 and increases as you gain Rogue levels, to a maximum of 10d6.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know Thieves' Cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that lets you hide a message inside a seemingly normal conversation. Only a creature that also knows Thieves' Cant understands it.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change one of those choices.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

features.name: Rogue Subclass
features.description: You gain a Rogue subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Rogue levels.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this only if you haven't moved yet this turn, and after you use it your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Cunning Strike
description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can add one of the following effects by forgoing some of the Sneak Attack dice. The target must be within the reach or range of the attack.
**Poison (Cost: 1d6).** The target makes a Constitution saving throw or has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. You must have a Poisoner's Kit to use this option.
**Trip (Cost: 1d6).** If the target is Large or smaller, it makes a Dexterity saving throw or has the Prone condition.
**Withdraw (Cost: 1d6).** You move up to half your Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two more skills in which you have proficiency. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses one of them.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When an effect lets you make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and half damage on a failure. You can't use this while Incapacitated.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check that uses one of your skill or tool proficiencies, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.description: You can use up to two Cunning Strike options when you deal Sneak Attack damage, forgoing the dice cost of each.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Devious Strikes
description: You gain three more Cunning Strike options.
**Daze (Cost: 2d6).** The target makes a Constitution saving throw or, on its next turn, can either move or take an action, not both, and can't take a Bonus Action.
**Knock Out (Cost: 6d6).** The target makes a Constitution saving throw or has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute or until it takes damage or a creature takes an action to wake it.
**Obscure (Cost: 3d6).** The target makes a Dexterity saving throw or has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has Advantage against you while you don't have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
description: If you fail a D20 Test, you can turn the roll into a 20.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: You can use the Bonus Action from Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use Thieves' Tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
In addition, when you make a running Long Jump, the distance it covers increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks on any turn that you move no more than half your Speed. You can also take the Hide action as part of the Bonus Action from Cunning Action.

features.name: Use Magic Device
description: **Attunement.** You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
**Charges.** Whenever you use a magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6. On a 6, you use the property without expending any charges.
**Scroll.** You can use any Spell Scroll, making an Intelligence check to cast the spell if its level is higher than you can normally cast.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat: your normal turn, and a second turn at your Initiative count minus 10. You can't do this if you are Surprised.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You augment your roguish talents with magic drawn from the wizard spell list, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for these spells. You can use an Arcane Focus as a spellcasting focus for them.

**Cantrips.** You learn three cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list, one of which must be Mage Hand. Whenever you gain a Rogue level, you can replace one of these cantrips with a different one from the wizard spell list.
**Spell Slots.** You gain spell slots for casting spells of 1st through 4th level, following the progression for this feature; you regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

**Spells Known.** At 3rd level, you learn three 1st-level spells of your choice from the wizard spell list, with no restriction to a particular school of magic. The number of spells you know grows as you gain Rogue levels, and whenever you gain a level in this class, you can replace one spell you know with another wizard spell of a level you can cast.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
description: The mage hand cantrip you learn through Spellcasting becomes especially deft in your hands: you can cast it as a Bonus Action instead of an action and without a verbal component, and you can make its spectral hand invisible.

While using the Bonus Action from Cunning Action to control the hand, you can also make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, or have the hand take the Utilize action on an object it touches — including using a set of thieves' tools to disarm a trap or pick a lock — without you needing to be within reach of that object yourself.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: If you have the Invisible condition when you cast a spell against a creature, that creature has Disadvantage on any saving throw it makes against the spell on the same turn.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: When you use the Trip option of Cunning Strike, you can also apply its effect to a second creature within 5 feet of your mage hand, without spending an additional Cunning Strike die to do so.

features.name: Spell Thief
description: When a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area of effect, you can use your Reaction to force that creature to make an Intelligence saving throw against your spell save DC.

On a failed save, the spell has no effect on you, and if the spell is 1st level or higher and of a level you can cast, you steal the knowledge of it: for the next 8 hours, you have that spell prepared through this feature, and the creature that cast it can't cast that spell again until those 8 hours have passed.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Assassinate
description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

In addition, during the first round of combat you have Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet. If you hit such a creature with your Sneak Attack, the target takes extra damage, of the same type as the attack's damage, equal to your Rogue level.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.description: You gain proficiency with the Disguise Kit and the Poisoner's Kit, and you gain one of each if you don't already own them.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
description: **Masterful Mimicry.** After spending at least 1 hour studying a creature's speech, handwriting, or both, you can convincingly imitate what you studied.
**Roving Aim.** When you use the Rogue's Steady Aim feature, your Speed is no longer reduced to 0.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.description: When you use the Poison option of Cunning Strike, the target also takes 2d6 Poison damage whenever it fails the saving throw — including any saving throw it repeats at the end of its turns while affected — and this extra damage ignores Resistance to Poison damage.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with your Sneak Attack during the first round of combat, that creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or the damage of your attack is doubled against it.

features.name: Psionic Power
description: You manifest a wellspring of psionic power as a pool of Psionic Energy Dice, starting as d6s. You have a number of these dice equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus, and their size increases as you gain Rogue levels: to a d8 at 5th level, a d10 at 11th level, and a d12 at 17th level. You regain one expended die when you finish a Short Rest and all of them when you finish a Long Rest.

**Psi-Bolstered Knack.** When you fail an ability check using a skill or tool with which you're proficient, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die and add the number rolled to the check; the die is expended only if doing so turns the check into a success.

**Psychic Whispers.** As a Magic action, choose a number of creatures you can see, up to a number equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and roll one Psionic Energy Die. For that many hours, you and the chosen creatures can speak telepathically with each other whenever you're within 1 mile of one another, and any of you can end your own connection early with no action required. The first time you use this feature after a Long Rest, you don't expend the die; each additional use before your next Long Rest expends one.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: As part of the Attack action or as an Opportunity Attack, you can manifest a blade of psychic energy in an empty hand and attack with it in place of a weapon. It is a Simple Melee weapon with the Finesse and Thrown properties (range 60/120 feet) and the Vex mastery property, dealing 1d6 Psychic damage plus your ability modifier on a hit; it vanishes the instant it hits or misses, leaving no physical mark. If your other hand is free, you can manifest and attack with a second blade as a Bonus Action on the same turn, dealing 1d4 Psychic damage plus your ability modifier on a hit.

features.name: Soul Blades
description: Your Psychic Blades grow more potent, fueled by your Psionic Energy Dice.

**Homing Strikes.** When an attack roll you make with a Psychic Blade misses, you can roll one Psionic Energy Die and add the result to the roll; if this turns the miss into a hit, the die is expended, and otherwise it isn't.

**Psychic Teleportation.** As a Bonus Action, you manifest a Psychic Blade, then expend and roll one Psionic Energy Die and hurl the blade at an unoccupied space you can see, up to a number of feet away equal to 10 times the number rolled. You then teleport into that space, and the blade disappears.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: As a Magic action, you weave your psionic power into a veil around yourself, gaining the Invisible condition for 1 hour or until you end the effect (no action required). The invisibility ends immediately if you deal damage to a creature or force a creature to make a saving throw. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend one Psionic Energy Die to use it again.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with a Psychic Blade, you can force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the target has the Stunned condition for 1 minute, repeating the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend three Psionic Energy Dice to use it again.

features.name: Spellcasting
description: You cast Sorcerer spells using Charisma, and you can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus.
You know four cantrips from the Sorcerer spell list and learn more as you gain levels.
You know a set number of Sorcerer spells rather than preparing them, and you can swap one for another whenever you gain a Sorcerer level.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
description: As a Bonus Action, you unleash your innate magic for 1 minute. It ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition or die.
For the duration, the save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1, and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.
You can use this twice, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Font of Magic
description: You have Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level, and you regain all of them when you finish a Long Rest.
As a Bonus Action, you can convert Sorcery Points into a spell slot, or convert a spell slot into Sorcery Points.

features.name: Metamagic
description: You gain two Metamagic options of your choice, each of which lets you spend Sorcery Points to alter one of your spells.
You gain two more options at Sorcerer levels 10 and 17, and whenever you gain a Sorcerer level you can replace one option with another.

features.name: Sorcerer Subclass
features.description: You gain a Sorcerer subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Sorcerer levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can regain expended Sorcery Points up to a number equal to half your Sorcerer level. Once you do this, you can't again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
description: If you have no uses of Innate Sorcery left, you can activate it by spending 2 Sorcery Points.
In addition, while Innate Sorcery is active, you can use up to two Metamagic options when casting a single spell.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.description: While Innate Sorcery is active, you can use one Metamagic option on each of your turns without spending Sorcery Points on it.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a Sorcerer level.
In addition, while you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Draconic Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your total, each becoming available at the Sorcerer level shown.
**Level 3.** Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command, Dragon's Breath
**Level 5.** Fear, Fly
**Level 7.** Arcane Eye, Charm Monster
**Level 9.** Legend Lore, Summon Dragon

features.name: Elemental Affinity
description: Choose one damage type associated with dragons: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.

When you cast a Sorcerer spell that deals damage of the chosen type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell. You can also spend 1 Sorcery Point as you cast it to gain Resistance to that damage type for 10 minutes.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you sprout draconic wings that last 1 hour or until you dismiss them. While they are out, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover, but you can't use them if you are wearing armor not made to accommodate them.

features.name: Dragon Companion
description: You always have the Summon Dragon spell prepared, and you can cast it once without expending a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest.
In addition, when you cast a spell that targets only one creature, you can have the dragon you summoned with Summon Dragon use its Reaction to make one Rend attack against that creature.

features.name: Psionic Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your total, each becoming available at the Sorcerer level shown.
**Level 3.** Arms of Hadar, Calm Emotions, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Sliver
**Level 5.** Hunger of Hadar, Sending
**Level 7.** Evard's Black Tentacles, Summon Aberration
**Level 9.** Rary's Telepathic Bond, Telekinesis

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: As a Bonus Action, you can open a telepathic link with one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. While the two of you remain within a number of miles of each other equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), you can converse telepathically, though each of you must mentally use a language the other understands. The link lasts for a number of minutes equal to your Sorcerer level, or until you use this feature again to link with someone else.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: When you cast a spell you have prepared from Psionic Spells, you can pay for it with Sorcery Points equal to its level instead of a spell slot. A spell cast this way needs no Verbal or Somatic components, and it needs no Material components either, unless those components are consumed by the spell or carry a cost.

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws made to resist or shake off being Charmed or Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
description: As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 or more Sorcery Points to twist your body with aberrant power for 10 minutes. For each point you spend, choose one of the benefits below; the chosen benefits last until the transformation ends.
**Aquatic Adaptation.** You gain a Swim Speed equal to twice your Speed and can breathe underwater.
**Glistening Flight.** You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover.
**See the Invisible.** You can see Invisible creatures within 60 feet of you that aren't behind Total Cover.

**Wormlike Movement.** Your body becomes pliable enough to squeeze through any gap at least 1 inch wide, and you can spend 5 feet of movement to slip free of a nonmagical restraint or the Grappled condition.

features.name: Warping Implosion
description: As a Magic Action, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of yourself, and the space you leave violently collapses inward. Every creature within 30 feet of that space must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC.
On a failed save, a creature takes 3d10 Force damage and is dragged to the nearest unoccupied space next to where you vanished; on a success, it takes half as much damage and isn't moved.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Clockwork Spells
description: The following spells are always prepared for you and don't count against your total, each becoming available at the Sorcerer level shown.
**Level 3.** Aid, Alarm, Lesser Restoration, Protection from Evil and Good
**Level 5.** Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy
**Level 7.** Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct
**Level 9.** Greater Restoration, Wall of Force

In addition, whenever you cast a Sorcerer spell, your bond to cosmic order shows itself through some small, orderly manifestation of your choice, such as spectral cogwheels, a brassy sheen on your skin, or the faint ticking of an unseen clock.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: As a Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you is about to roll a d20 with Advantage or Disadvantage, you can cancel that Advantage or Disadvantage before the die is rolled. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: As a Magic Action, you can spend 1 to 5 Sorcery Points to raise a shimmering ward of order around yourself or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The ward grants a number of d8s equal to the Sorcery Points spent; whenever the warded creature takes damage, it can expend any number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the damage by the total rolled. The ward lasts until you finish a Long Rest or until you create a new one with this feature.

features.name: Trance of Order
description: As a Bonus Action, you can enter a meditative trance for 1 minute, aligning your mind with the exacting calculations of Mechanus. While the trance lasts, attack rolls against you can never benefit from Advantage, and whenever you make a D20 Test, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you spend 5 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
description: As a Magic Action, you summon intangible, invulnerable spirits of order, shaped like modrons or other Constructs of your choosing, filling a 30-foot Cube originating from you. Before vanishing, the spirits produce any of the following effects you choose within the Cube.
**Heal.** The spirits restore up to 100 Hit Points, divided as you choose among any creatures in the Cube.
**Repair.** Any damaged objects entirely within the Cube are instantly mended.
**Dispel.** Every spell of 6th level or lower ends on any creatures and objects you choose in the Cube.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you spend 7 Sorcery Points (no action required) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Once on each of your turns, immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell using a spell slot, you can roll a d20. On a roll of 20, you immediately roll on the Wild Magic Surge table and apply the result. If that result is itself a spell, it erupts too wildly for your Metamagic to shape it.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
description: Before making a D20 Test, you can call on chaotic magic to give yourself Advantage on the roll. Once you do, you can't use this feature again until you cast a Sorcerer spell using a spell slot or finish a Long Rest.
If you cast a Sorcerer spell using a spell slot before that Long Rest, doing so automatically triggers a roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Immediately after another creature you can see rolls the d20 for a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction and spend 1 Sorcery Point to roll 1d4 and apply the result as a bonus or penalty, your choice, to that roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you roll twice and choose which of the two results applies.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.description: Immediately after you cast a Sorcerer spell using a spell slot, you can forgo rolling on the Wild Magic Surge table and instead choose any effect on it other than the table's final entry; if the chosen effect calls for a roll, you still make it. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
description: You learn Eldritch Invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that grant an ongoing magical ability. You start knowing one and learn more as you gain Warlock levels.
Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one Invocation you know with another for which you qualify.

features.name: Pact Magic
description: You cast Warlock spells using Charisma, and you can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus. You know two cantrips from the Warlock spell list and learn more as you gain levels.
Your spell slots are few in number and are always the same, highest level you can cast, and you regain all of them when you finish a Short Rest or a Long Rest.
You know a set number of Warlock spells and can swap one for another whenever you gain a Warlock level.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.description: When you finish a Short Rest, you can perform a one-minute ritual to regain expended Pact Magic spell slots, up to a number equal to half your maximum (rounded up). Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Warlock Subclass
features.description: You gain a Warlock subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Warlock levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Contact Patron
description: You always have the Contact Other Plane spell prepared.
You can cast it to contact your patron without expending a spell slot, and you automatically succeed on the spell's saving throw. You regain this free use when you finish a Long Rest.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th Level)
description: Choose one level 6 spell from the Warlock spell list as an arcanum.

You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a Short Rest or a Long Rest. You can replace the chosen spell whenever you gain a Warlock level.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (8th Level)
features.description: Choose one level 8 Warlock spell as an arcanum. You can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that use on a Short Rest or a Long Rest, and you can replace the chosen spell when you gain a Warlock level.
